summary: An integral vector of the definite middle lattice with all archimedean norms < 1 is zero.

steps.lean:
l a i = 0 := congr($(S.eq_zero_of_ratMiddle_form_eq_zero (lᵀ i ⊕ᵥ 0) rfl
  (eq_zero_of_norm_Φ (by simpa [↓gram_mul, ↓gram_classCoordX₀, ← algebraMap_mem_Ô] using
  (h.isInt_conjTranspose.mul S.isUnimodular_latMiddle.isIntMatrix).mul h i i)
  (by simp; grw [norm_sum_le]; simpa [← sq]))) (.inl a))
steps.claim: The vector (column i of l, 0) has middle form value an algebraic integer (h, unimodular middle lattice, gram of classCoordX₀) with |Φ_v| < 1 at every v (H), hence 0 (eq_zero_of_norm_Φ); the vector is then 0 (eq_zero_of_ratMiddle_form_eq_zero), so l_{ai} = 0.
